description: The UNS path and the hub address of every scope=hub signal that no route in sites/werk1/sync/ declares (owner 24.09.). Full text: docs/history/standard/sync/uns-convention.md, description.

ot.$note: Profiles of category machine. One subject per signal; the fixed token telemetry|event separates the two delivery classes.

it.$note: Profiles of category business (ERP/QMS/WMS, Level 3/4). One subject per source row; the attribute rides as a field of the payload. Level 4 (isa95.level) is enterprise-wide and has no site in its path. eventType (created|updated|deleted) and id (the row key) are filled at runtime.
